verdict.rationale: Algolia's llms.txt lists 'AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search' as a product capability, and the probe confirms it positions itself as offering AI-powered semantic search alongside full-text search. That directly matches the story's hybrid keyword-plus-vector axis, but the evidence is only a one-line index entry. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing keyword and vector results fused in a single query (API parameters, ranking/fusion behavior), plan or availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NeuralSearch.
